sys_script_include.description: Builds the outbound VAMP payload (envelope plus one finding element) for an application vulnerable item. Sections and their fields come from the properties usem.vamp.avit.sections and usem.vamp.avit.fields.<section>.
sys_script_include.name: BOFASIVampOutboundProcessor

sys_script_include.description: Sends a VAMP payload to the Kafka topic held in usem.vamp.kafka.topic_sys_id with sn_ih_kafka.ProducerV2 (key <table>.<sys_id>). Documentation of API used - https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/api-reference/server-api-reference/ProducerV2ScopedAPI.html
sys_script_include.name: BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp

sys_properties.description: sys_id of the Kafka Topic record [sys_kafka_topic] for sn_usem_verification_outbound, read by BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.kafka.topic_sys_id

sys_properties.description: Fields of the VAMP finding payload for sn_vul_app_vulnerable_item, one servicenow_field=json_field pair per line in payload order. The ServiceNow field may dot-walk from the item (cmdb_ci.name; remediation_task.number reaches the item's remediation task); a dot in the json field nests it (ci.name). A field missing on the table or empty is sent as "".
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.finding.fields.sn_vul_app_vulnerable_item
sys_properties.value: number=finding.number, sys_created_on=finding.sys_created_on, sys_updated_on=finding.sys_updated_on, state=finding.state, cmdb_ci=finding.configuration_item, u_verification_status=finding.u_verification_status, source_avit_id=finding.source_avit_id, vulnerability.number=tpe.number, remediation_task.number=remediation_task.number, remediation_task.primary_ait=remediation_task.primary_ait, application_release.u_primary_ait.number=ait.number, cmdb_ci.name=ci.name, cmdb_ci.sys_class_name=ci.class_name, change_approval.number=exception.number, change_approval.approval_state=exception.approval_state, change_approval.desired_validity_date=exception.desired_validity_date, u_consequence.number=consequence.number, u_consequence.state=consequence.state, u_consequence.u_consequence_level=consequence.u_consequence_level, assessment_request.number=ptreq.number, assessment_request.sys_created_on=ptreq.sys_created_on, assessment_request.u_assessment_id=ptreq.u_assessment_id,

sys_script.description: Builds the VAMP payload for the application vulnerable item with BOFASIVampOutboundProcessor and sends it with BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp on every insert and update.
sys_script.name: BOFA_BR_AVIT_VampOutbound
